name: Nagi Imaging
description: A theme for a small diagnostic imaging centre that reads scans for nearby clinics the same day. The home page opens on a scattered field of seven rounded low-key photographs that drift at different speeds, with the headline on pure white strips crossing the console photograph and a light-grey bottom half with a ticker bar; it continues with a studies list, a pinned statement that turns the page from white to slate mist, the reporting method, a full-width fee table, a parallax reading-room photograph, referrer notes in a scattered row, the team and the visit block. Public Sans over Atkinson Hyperlegible. Ten inner pages repeat the photo field and white-strip titles and close on slate mist. Sample content in English; other languages follow. Works without WooCommerce.

fonts.role: display: huge section words, headline strips, statements, prices (variable 100-900, Latin subset)
